## Change class

- [ ] Editorial
- [ ] Clarification
- [ ] Normative additive
- [ ] Normative breaking
- [ ] Research / experimental

## Affected material

Specification sections:

Requirement IDs:

Schemas/profiles/tests:

## Rationale / counterexample

Describe the problem this change addresses.

## Compatibility impact

Describe migration or interoperability impact.

## Evidence

List tests, analyses, references, implementations, or other evidence.

## Claim discipline

- [ ] No finite test is represented as universal proof.
- [ ] No conformance claim is represented as legal compliance.
- [ ] No package claim is represented as deployment non-bypassability without deployment evidence.
- [ ] No proprietary runtime implementation material or secrets are included.
